# Review Report

## Summary

Local deterministic review of Maya's 30-minute mailbox/task-intake candidate.
The executed gate covers Composio Gmail, Linear, and Slack workflow behavior.
The complete listener suite reports 90/90 passing.

## Findings

NO FINDINGS in the machine-checked workflow contract.
Every message becomes ignore, track, or block.
Actionable mail creates a source-linked [MAYA] Linear task.
Blocked work creates a task and a [NA-5][MAYA] Slack packet.
Successfully handled unread mail becomes read.

## Clean

Duplicate Gmail IDs cannot create duplicate task intake.
No sender reply or email send is claimed.
The documented scope is intake and routing, not material attachment work.

## Assumptions

The pinned Linear team is PE-CC-DevTeam.
This gate does not access external systems.
This gate does not inspect real email content.
Deployment remains contingent on all Ringer checks.
The report is evidence of local checks, not human approval.
No P0 or P1 is open in this bounded contract.

MACHINE_VERDICT: PASS
MOCK_END
